title: Minigame One
description: A fun little game where you click as fast as possible to earn points.
how_to_play:
1. Press Play to start the game.
2. Click on targets as quickly as you can.
3. Each hit gives points.
4. Avoid missing targets.
5. Try to beat your high score!

Tips:
- Focus on the center of the screen.
- Stay calm and do not rush.
